findings.summary: Duplicate replay fingerprint omits pinned policy epoch
findings.details: Duplicate replay validation records deliveryKey plus observationKey/sourceRevisionKey/sourceUnitKey/assemblyJobKey. The accepted duplicate path then allows buildSourceLedgerRows to construct a processing job with the replay input policyEpoch. A same-delivery replay with the same revision and assembly job but a changed policyEpoch can therefore return outcome duplicate while changing the pinned policy epoch required by the task contract.

findings.summary: Duplicate replay fingerprint omits immutable revision metadata
findings.details: The task requires content-bearing rows to preserve exact immutable revision metadata including author snapshot and permalink. The duplicate replay fence only compares keys derived from provider object, revision nonce, text/blocks/tombstone/order/timestamp, thread, and effect. It does not bind author snapshot or permalink, so a same-delivery replay can be accepted as duplicate while buildSourceLedgerRows returns altered revision rows.
